corrections.text: The article does not state that Anthropic, whose sampling-parameter removal in API version 2026-10-21 and model-level text watermark are central subjects here, makes the Claude models that produced and reviewed this article for The Machine Herald. Readers should weigh the article's treatment of Anthropic's controls with that relationship in mind; every statement about Anthropic is attributed to The Decoder, TechCrunch or Anthropic's own migration guide.

The article says Ramp 'described moving model selection into its open-source coding agent Open SWE this month'. The New Stack report it draws on is dated October 28, 2026, so 'this month' refers to October, not to the month of this article's publication.
